locations.note: Ryo rescues Shenhua Ling in the Guilin mountains and finds her father missing at a stone quarry, where the sword and phoenix mirror reveal a mural.
Ryo arrives in 1987 in search of Master Lishao Tao, who refuses to help him, and starts among the markets and martial-arts halls.
Ren tells Ryo that Yuanda Zhu is hiding in the Walled City, where the Yellow Head gang kidnaps Zhu and Ryo goes after him.

routes.name: Ryo Hazuki
routes.note: From Wan Chai through the Walled City to the Guilin mountains.
